profile.headline: programmer Fastrax POS
profile.summary: Over 25 years as a Software Developer/SQL Programmer utilizing Scrum methodology. Hands-on experience includes writing code in Visual Basic, C# creating Mobile Apps, Windows Apps, and Web Services. As well as MS SQL Server programmer, writing/debugging structured query language, creating reports using SQL reporting services/business intelligence applications and Crystal Reports; CRUD databases, tables, and data by writing and debugging stored procedures and functions with complex joins. Experience includes working within strict deadlines and multiple projects where priority management is crucial.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Microsoft Office · Microsoft SQL Server · Programming · SQL Report Writing · Visual Basic · Visual C# · Visual Studio

positions.title: SQL Programmer
positions.description:
The creation, deployment and maintenance of reports using MS SQL Server Reporting Services. 
The recreating of existing reports from other applications (Crystal Reports) in SSRR. The writing, debugging and deployment of stored procedures and functions within SQL. Utilizing established programming standards in compliance with the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act of 2002. Creation and maintenance of various databases systems, including but not limited to: MS Access, SQL server 2000 / 2005 / 2008 / 2012. Provided production support and enhancements to both Legacy software systems and new applications.

positions.title: Programmer analysis Assoc.
positions.description:
Responsibilities included: 
Writing/debugging structured query language with stored procedures and functions with complex joins, creating reports using MS SQL reporting services/ business intelligence applications. Designing and documenting of database schema as well as the creation and maintenance of DTS/SSIS packages. Writing code for software applications and modules, as well the writing of operating documentation of the detailed software in accordance with Agile-SCRUM methodology. Evaluating, modifying, testing, debugging, and implementing existing software applications, modules, and systems in order to effectively maintain data integrity, optimize system performance, and output accuracy. Providing support for applications and end users- including software support, understanding end-users needs of the software and identifying either software or process improvements to enhance productivity. Expanding and improving technical skill sets in addition to working with other programmers to increase knowledge of development languages, software tools, and techniques.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Responsibilities included: Providing application design, architecture, application testing, and technical support including design and user documentation.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description: Responsibilities included: Providing tier1 technical support for end-users/customers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included: Technical writing, configuration management, and software design.
Creation and distribution of monthly status reports. Responsible for maintaining the Technical Information Library. Configuration management duties included: Documentation of changes to the new baseline application release in regards to the previous release. Compare the documented changes to submitted Change Requests (CR). Generate a discrepancy report.
Creation and testing of entities in ModSAF. Set up and test the interaction between ModSAF, and the MetaVR 3D representation.

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included: 
Provided technical and administration assistance to the Hawk Missile Fire Control Team for the Singapore and Sweden Projects. Creating and maintaining of Technical Drawing using Visio Technical and TurboCAD. Assisted in the construction of firing shelters and trainers, which included: Assisting in the fabrication, running and labeling of the wires and cables.	
The installation of hardware components into the cabinets. Provided administrative assistance including setting up of labs and offices. Delivery needed information to CIC help desk for the creation of new accounts for new employees. Maintained the PICIS Integration lab.
Set-up and configuration of workstations. Installation and testing of software .
 technical assistance to GEMS Service Center. Creation of PICIS training documentation using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. Collection of accounting data from service center machines and the creation of the GEMS computer usage accounting report each month using Excel. Designed and developed the operator’s manual for the site security application of Davis-Besse Nuclear Power Station. The draft manual was tested against the system and revised as necessary. 
Created the Help file using Doc-To- Help.

positions.title: Electrican's Mate
positions.description:
Responsibilities included: Electrician’s Mate – Designing, installation, and maintenance of electrical components. Including but not limited to: receptacles, lights, electrical valves, and electrical motors.  
Master-at-Arms – On-board security and law enforcement. Shore Patrol – On-shore security during liberty ports of call.
